content: We need number of C=O groups in the molecule. We have carbon NMR shifts list: 88.85, 69.70, 68.60, 67.50, 31.31, 28.70, 27.60, 22.65, 18.60, 14.05 ppm. Carbonyl carbons typically appear around 160-220 ppm. None of these are in that region. So likely zero carbonyl groups. Could double-check with IR for C=O stretch ~1700 cm-1. Let's get IR.
